_comment: SDXL person-replace workflow (ComfyUI API format). Same proven shape as replace_object.json. The mask is the full PERSON footprint, so the background and neighbouring objects are outside the mask and stay fixed. The init image is prepared by backend/comfy_person.py: in UPLOAD mode it is the old person removed (coarse inpaint) with the uploaded person composited into the footprint (clipped to the silhouette, background discarded); in PROMPT mode it is the original crop, so denoising anchors to the original person's scale/angle/orientation. SDXL regenerates only the masked person -> for upload at low denoise (harmonise), for prompt at higher denoise (generate). The graph STRUCTURE lives here; comfy_person.py injects per-request VALUES by node id. Flow: load checkpoint -> encode prompts -> VAE-encode the init -> restrict denoising to the person mask via SetLatentNoiseMask -> KSampler -> decode -> save.

inputs.text: extra people, extra limbs, deformed, distorted, blurry, lowres, artifacts, seam, floating, cut off, watermark, text
